name: Bloodscalp Clan Heads

meta.next: Speaking with Gan'zulah, Speaking with Nezzliok (Classic)

summary: Nimboya still seeks word of Yenniku after the trophies are sorted. The young troll is missing, so the Darkspear turn to the Bloodscalp Clan Heads for answers.

sections.title: Demanding Answers from the Dead
sections.body: Nimboya seeks answers from the Bloodscalp leaders. The earlier hunt found no sign of Yenniku among the fallen. Gan'zulah, the Bloodscalp chief, and Nezzliok the Dire, his witch doctor, are enemies of the Darkspear. Neither would speak willingly. So Nimboya plans to bring their heads to the cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp and force the truth from their dead lips.

sections.title: Into Zul'Kunda
sections.body: Gan'zulah and Nezzliok dwell deep in the ruins of Zul'Kunda in northwestern Stranglethorn Vale. Nimboya means to cast their heads into the boiling brew and make them speak about Yenniku.

faq.q: Why does Nimboya want the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok?
faq.answer: Yenniku remains missing, and Nimboya believes Gan'zulah and Nezzliok know the truth. They are enemies of the Darkspear and would never speak willingly, so he plans to force answers from them through the cauldron.

faq.q: Where are Gan'zulah and Nezzliok located?
faq.answer: Gan'zulah and Nezzliok dwell deep within Zul'Kunda, a ruin in northwestern Stranglethorn Vale, close to the beach.

faq.q: What happens once the heads are delivered?
aliases: what do i do with the heads
faq.answer: The severed heads go into the bubbling cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp. There, Nimboya means to make the two leaders speak.

faq.q: How does this connect to the search for Yenniku?
faq.answer: The search began with young Yenniku. The earlier hunt found no sign of him among the common dead, so the Darkspear now seek answers from the Bloodscalp leaders to learn where he is.

angles.text: As a Darkspear, you face the leaders of an enemy tribe when you confront the Bloodscalp chiefs.
As a member of the Horde, you lend your strength at Grom'gol Base Camp to the Darkspear search for Yenniku.
